title: DCI: Dependency Confidence Index for Assessing Open-Source Dependency Trustworthiness
abstract: arXiv:2608.16430v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Selecting trustworthy open source software dependencies remains a major challenge in software supply chain security. We present the Dependency Confidence Index (DCI), a composite formative index that combines nine empirically weighted trust factors into a single normalized composite score for dependency selection. DCI's trust factors combine insights from a systematic literature review and an exploratory Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) survey of ten software developers, highlighting security, source code quality, and project health as the most influential dimensions. Following Goal-Question-Metric methodology, we implemented 12 automated measurements using SonarQube, GitHub APIs, and OpenSSF Scorecard data, deployed in a containerized evaluation platform. We conducted a pilot evaluation of the normalized DCI on 92 popular PyPI packages, observing moderate agreement with OpenSSF Scorecard scores and perfect test--retest reliability. Anal

translated_title: DCI：评估开源依赖可信度的依赖置信指数
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16430v1 公告类型：新 摘要：选择可信的开源软件依赖仍是软件供应链安全中的重大挑战。我们提出了依赖置信指数（DCI），这是一个复合形成性指数，它将九个经验加权的信任因素合并为一个归一化的复合评分，用于依赖选择。DCI的信任因素结合了系统性文献综述和一项对十名软件开发者的探索性层次分析法（AHP）调查的见解，强调安全性、源代码质量和项目健康度是最具影响力的维度。遵循目标-问题-度量方法论，我们使用SonarQube、GitHub API和OpenSSF Scorecard数据实现了12项自动化测量，并部署在一个容器化评估平台上。我们对92个流行的PyPI包进行了归一化DCI的试点评估，观察到与OpenSSF Scorecard评分的中等一致性以及完美的测试-重测可靠性。
tldr: DCI提出了一种结合九个加权信任因素的综合指数，通过自动化测量评估开源依赖的可信度，并在PyPI包上验证了其有效性和可靠性。
en_tdlr: DCI proposes a composite index combining nine weighted trust factors to assess open-source dependency trustworthiness, validated on PyPI packages for effectiveness and reliability.
